title: Event Horizon — Master
description: Original 150 BPM electronic soundtrack included. Expert musical turns: sweeping calls, counter-turn answers and cadences, with notes throughout. Wide linked chords, independent hand rails, stationary constellations, ducking and leaning. 2:40. Room scale 1.2 widens the authored layout.
